from pathlib import Path
import re
names=['canonical_root','contains','resolve_recorded_root','escape','grammar_versions']
for name in names:
    hits=[]
    for p in Path('crates/cli/src').rglob('*.rs'):
        b=p.read_bytes()
        for m in re.finditer(rb'\\bfn\\s+'+name.encode()+rb'\\b',b):
            start=m.end()-len(name); end=start+len(name)
            line=b.count(b'\\n',0,start)+1
            hits.append((p.as_posix(),line,start,end))
    print(name,*hits[0])
'@ | python -"
